label: Listening 1 — Sam's family photo
lines: Listening one. Sam talks about a family photo. Write the ages.
Hi, I'm Sam. This is a photo of my family. This is my mother. She's forty-one.
Next to her is my father. He's forty-five.
This little girl is my sister, Kate. She's eight.
And this is my grandmother. She's seventy-two.
Oh, and this tall boy is my cousin, Oliver. He's fifteen.

label: Listening 2 — Have you got…?
lines: Listening two. Have you got…? Five children answer. True or false?
Leo, have you got a sister?
No, I haven't. I've got two brothers.
Yes, I have. I've got a cousin in Spain.
Jack, have you got a pet?
Yes, I have. I've got a dog. His name is Rex.
Amy, tell me about your grandparents.
They've got a small house near the sea.
And you, Daniel? Have you got a brother?
No, I haven't. I've got one sister.

label: Listening 3 — A new student
lines: Listening three. Lucy, a new student, talks to her teacher. Listen and complete.
So, Lucy, tell me about your family. Have you got brothers or sisters?
I've got one brother. His name is Jake.
My mum is a nurse and my dad is a taxi driver.
Yes, I have. I've got three cousins.
My grandmother lives with us. She's eighty!
